name: Skpr Logs
description: Logs system events for the Skpr hosting platform.
project_description:
A module for enabling standardised logging on the Skpr Hosting Platform.

 Features 
 * Outputs logs in JSON format to preserve multi line and allow for querying

* Adds a skpr_component field for filtering in logging solutions

* Adds a request_id field for tracing in logging solutions.

 Post-Installation 
 All configuration is automatic. You will notice JSON logs starting to be printed to stderr.
